cost_accounting_note: Funding cost is charged unscaled by leverage in basket.simulate_basket (equity drag should be lev*fund, not fund), understating costs by up to MAX_LEVERAGE=5x. Biases optimistic. Turnover costs are lev-scaled. A closed_negative verdict is conservative-credible; a paper_candidate upset must be re-checked with lev-scaled funding.
kill_rule: closed_negative => structural diversification does not defeat the wall; no v2, no parameter rescue.
lane_description: Single frozen beta-neutral, vol-targeted, risk-parity basket of donchian-breakout drift legs across a survivorship-clean perp universe; judged once through the standard ladder. Tests whether structural diversification defeats the directional drawdown wall.
